description: Parking Space Levy assessments is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Revenue NSW. Dataset includes total number of liable car parks, client identifiers, car park location, category, number of spaces and number of liable spaces. Also included in the dataset are the dollar values for casual and unlet concessions accorded the relevant car park. For further information on Parking Space Levy visit the OSR website. Coverage: Revenue NSW. The portal files it under the publisher  Revenue NSW. Its tags are Levy, Parking Space Levy. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
